topik: Three-Dimensional Surface Displacement Response of Semi-Rigid Pavements with Varying CTB Thickness
latar_belakang: reported FEM outputs are predominantly limited to vertical deflection, horizontal tensile strain, and vertical compressive strain. The lateral displacement component (U1) and the longitudinal displacement component (U3) at the wearing course level — and particularly the differential displacement between the top and bottom of the surface course, which reflects internal deformation within the layer most exposed to direct traffic contact — have received very limited systematic attention. This gap is especially pronounced for semi-rigid pavements, where the high stiffness contrast between the CTB layer and the overlying asphalt creates a distinct mechanical boundary condition expected to produce surface displacement behavior fundamentally different from that of conventional flexible structures
